title: Emergency Repairs to Address Flooding / Harry Bridges Boulevard / Alameda Street / Wilmington
motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the City Council direct the Bureau of Sanitation (LASAN), in coordination with the Los Angeles Department of Transportation (LADOT) and the Bureau of Engineering (BOE), to identify and implement immediate mitigation measures and expedite emergency repairs to address flooding at Harry Bridges Boulevard and Alameda Street in Wilmington. These conditions threaten the safety and reliability of critical goods movement routes as detour routes associated with the Vincent Thomas Bridge closure are formalized pursuant to Council File 25-0712. I FURTHER MOVE that the City Council direct LADOT, in coordination with LASAN and BOE, to evaluate the current and anticipated detour routes and implement necessary measures, or emergency repairs, to prevent increased truck traffic from being diverted into Wilmington neighborhoods due to flooding or related infrastructure constraints, including appropriate truck routing, traffic management, signage, and other necessary mitigation measures. PRESENTED BY: / I — V) — TIM MeOSKER Councilmember, 15th District. SECONDED BY: ocr 1 3 2026
